chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 565: Why Zhuge Yuan Broke Li Huowang's Trust
chapter_meta_description: The trap is sprung! Li Huowang discovers Zhuge Yuan masterminded the entire scheme to save Great Qi, shattering their sacred bond of brotherhood.
og_title: The Ultimate Betrayal: Zhuge Yuan's Confession in Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 565
og_description: Zhuge Yuan admits to manipulating Li Huowang and Dice to save a dying world. A devastating chapter about trust, ambition, and the price of salvation.
twitter_title: The Blade-Tongued Scholar: Zhuge Yuan's Plan Revealed
twitter_description: Zhuge Yuan drops the biggest bomb of the arc: He played everyone, including Li Huowang, to steal a dragon vein for Great Qi. Ouch.

lore_anchors.definition: A corrupted Nian beast that drains yang life on contact; named to distinguish it from the traditional folkloric Nian.
Ancient beings who farmed humans as livestock; the ancestors of humanity escaped them and used the stolen Mandate to create their own sheltered world.
Refers to both a mahjong tile and a high-ranking, dangerous member of the Zuowandao. Li Huowang is suspected of being one, or being in contact with one.
